speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: Many of our Nanyang residents do not have walkable assess to the JRL Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) station, although four of the JRL stations are located in Nanyang, because three of the stations are located within the Nanyang Technological University.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast-Jurong West)
text: Will the Ministry of Transport (MOT) consider putting in additional bus services to connect my residents from Jurong West Streets 91 and 93 directly to the upcoming Gek Poh MRT station, in tandem with the opening of the new MRT station?

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: It would be I believe, a matter of time before the JRL is completed and they would see the benefits.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: As was mentioned by the hon Member, there are four MRT stations that they can access.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: And LTA regularly monitors the travel demand in this region.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: And we are continually reviewing them as and when the demand is expressed.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: A short supplementary question, Mr Ang, a final one.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
text: Just to clarify with the Senior Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: I am grateful to the hon Member for his clarification.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: I hope that the hon Member will be able to explain that to his residents.
